name: Which paint finish is best for mobile home interior walls?

mainEntity.name: Which paint finish is best for mobile home interior walls?

acceptedAnswer.text: Satin or eggshell sheens are typically the best choice for manufactured home walls. High-gloss finishes accentuate surface imperfections, panel waviness, and uneven seams common in factory-built homes. On the other hand, flat paints are difficult to clean and scuff easily in high-traffic hallways and tight living rooms. Eggshell and satin provide a balanced, soft sheen that reflects light gently while remaining washable. For kitchens, bathrooms, or utility rooms where moisture is common, a semi-gloss or premium mildew-resistant satin works best for durability and easy wipe-downs.
acceptedAnswer.description: Eggshell or satin finishes are ideal because they offer cleanability and resist scuffs without highlighting uneven wall surfaces the way high-gloss finishes do.
